external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Overcoming SDoH barriers with The Network & Findhelp

Expansion plans quickly turned into measurable growth. With support from The Network, Tennessee Cancer Specialists accelerated its growth strategy, opening a new office in Kingsport, adding two physicians and advancing plans for a new medical oncology-focused buildout in Greeneville. The practice also entered into an agreement with Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), helping make clinical research more manageable and financially viable while increasing patient access to innovative treatment
